name: citra-app-runtime
description: Multi-tenant Next.js runtime that renders Citra Power AI Apps from AppSpec JSON.
//overrides: next pins postcss to an exact version and carries sharp as an optional
dependency, so neither moves when next is patched -- postcss sat at 8.4.31
against advisories fixed in 8.5.23, and sharp at 0.34.5 against 0.35.0.
Overridden rather than bumping next, because next itself is not vulnerable
here: it was only the path npm attributes these two to.
